---
title: Interview invitations
description: Send a voice interview link for one bot, then read or export the ordered transcript.
translation:
  source: en
  status: complete
  sourceVersion: "2026-11-19"
---

Open **Interview invitations** (访谈邀请). **New interview invite** (新建访谈邀请) asks for one [interview bot](/build/bots/) and one or more invitee names. Each name gets its own link. The invite records the signed-in user.

The interviewee opens the link and starts a voice interview with that bot. The transcript is stored in time order. You can view it and export it from the invite.

An invite records what was said. It does not confirm that a statement is a business fact, and it does not create an Agent Package. Use the transcript when you write an [agent definition](/build/employee-definition/).
